scope: learned statistical reconstruction and action, not physiology or consciousness

checks.name: Cholesky/direct solver recovers a known SPD system
Computed inverse multiplies to identity
Reciprocal relaxation matches the exact fixture
Every coordinate minimization has the declared energy decrease
Conditional mean and variance match the analytic two-variable case
New independent observation gives the predicted variance reduction
Repeating identical observations falsely contracts conditional variance
Repeated sweeps do not add observation precision
Normal probability approximation matches standard values
Online learning matches a batch moment calculation
Within-model finite intervention matches conditional influence
Deleting a precision cross-term retains conditional rather than marginal variance
Deleting a covariance cross-term preserves marginal variance
All 12 seeds and all eight conditions exposed
Frozen learned organization preserved during every test
All query budgets are identical and exclude outcome access
Variance policy agrees with exact conditioning on all trials
Every probability and metric is finite
Descent failures are explicitly counted
Common reconstruction endpoint always uses the same six coordinates
Common and missing-coordinate losses coincide before extra sampling
